query:
SELECT u.roles AS "roles!: Vec<String>"
        FROM users u
        WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
              u.employee_id = $1
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM employees e
                  WHERE e.id = $1
                    AND e.company_id = $2
                    AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
                    AND e.email IS NOT NULL
                    AND btrim(e.email) <> ''
                    AND lower(btrim(u.email)) = lower(btrim(e.email))
              )
          )
